churn_resistance.rationale: The architecture would absorb an API or framework change well (one data module, view models at the load boundary, one config file), but there is no typing at the boundaries and a handful of copy-paste artifacts that a future edit would have to keep in sync.

findings.issue: goto() is called with keepFocus/noScroll/replaceState — all three options were removed in SvelteKit 3 (replaced by reset: false and replace). Kit 3.1.0 is pinned, so the options are silently ignored: every debounced search keystroke pushes a history entry and the page resets scroll and focus.
findings.suggestion: Use goto(url, { reset: false, replace: true }) (and keep the same fix in pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:12-17). This is both a correctness fix and a deprecation cleanup.

findings.issue: API base URL read directly from process.env, bypassing SvelteKit 3's environment-variable system ($env/* is deprecated in Kit 3 in favour of defineEnvVars + $app/env/private). Couples the app to Node/adapter-node and skips schema validation.
findings.suggestion: Add src/env.js with defineEnvVars({ API_BASE_URL: { schema: v.url() } }) and import { API_BASE_URL } from '$app/env/private'.

findings.issue: Sprite URL built inline, duplicating the spriteUrl() helper in pokeapi.js:147 — if the media path scheme changes there are two places to update.
findings.suggestion: Export spriteUrl from pokeapi.js (or build cards via buildCards) so the URL pattern has one source.

findings.issue: #lib/format imported without the .js extension; the Kit 3 migration guide explicitly says to add module extensions when moving from $lib, since Node subpath imports don't do extension resolution (this only works because Vite resolves it).

Copy-paste artifact: the .facts/.facts dt/.facts dd rules (identical to lines 587-601) are duplicated inside the @media (max-width: 700px) block with broken indentation; the intended mobile-only override (.relations) sits after it.
findings.suggestion: Delete the duplicated block, keeping only the genuinely responsive overrides.

findings.issue: Title and heading hardcode 'Not found' for every error status, so a 500 renders a page claiming Not found — a small correctness/churn trap.
findings.suggestion: Derive the heading from the page error's status/message (e.g. h1 {error?.status === 404 ? 'Not found' : 'Something went wrong'}).

findings.issue: include lists "vite.config.ts" but the config file is vite.config.js, so the vite config is not covered by editor checking (Kit 3 requires explicit include arrays, so this silently misses a file).
findings.suggestion: Change to "vite.config.js" (or rename the config to .ts).

findings.issue: buildCard and hiddenCard are near-identical copies differing only in the hidden flag.
findings.suggestion: Collapse to one factory: buildCard(id, name, hidden = false).

findings.issue: Non-standard <meta name="text-scale" content="scale"> — not a recognized platform feature; dead weight that future readers will puzzle over.
findings.suggestion: Remove it, or use the real platform equivalent (CSS text-size-adjust) if it was meant to control mobile text scaling.

findings.issue: untrack(() => data.filters) at component initialization is a no-op (nothing is being tracked during $state init), suggesting the rune is used decoratively rather than purposefully.
findings.suggestion: Plain assignment: let q = $state(data.filters.q); — untrack is only meaningful inside effects/deriveds.

summary: This is a genuinely current-generation SvelteKit app: Kit 3 vite-plugin configuration with the new parametric runes compiler option, #lib subpath imports, $app/state, runes and snippets throughout, and zero runtime dependencies. The one real lapse is the goto options in both interactive pages, which were removed in Kit 3 — against the pinned 3.1.0 that means actual behavior loss, not just style. Data access and formatting are cleanly centralized, so the codebase should age well once that and a few copy-paste artifacts are cleaned up.
